chapter: Trombone technique, plunger mute and the California years
title: When bands had one trombone and the section grew
summary: Early bands had one trumpet and a trombone, then two trumpets and a trombone, and the trombone part was usually written out.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: It used to be -- I guess when you started playing in bands they only had one trombone very often and --
Was his part written out or did he have to make it up himself?

No. A lot of times it was written out. If they had arrangements. Yeah, it was probably written out. Because if you had to play the trumpet you had to play it out. They always used to have just two trumpets and a trombone.
Before that they only had one trumpet and a trombone, but -- and a saxophone. And the saxophone (inaudible) long clarinet. You know. So, --
But the trombone was the last one to become a -- to become a section -- I guess -- you know.
